source: lab (captured, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB; background replaced by SAM2 demo - smooth colour gradient, watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' at x>=1025,y>=688)

camera.motion: static (static props' mask centroids vary by <=0.1 px std for bin/bag, <=0.5 px for carton/bear over all 49 frames)
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: fx = fy = 0.5959*1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360); no zoom
camera.view: oblique view looking down on a floor (background removed, so no floor texture/horizon visible). Objects lie on the floor; image-up corresponds to farther from the camera, image-down to nearer.
camera.perspective_cues: Only object sizes: the moving board's apparent size shrinks steadily as it moves up-left in the image (moving away from the camera). No ground lines or vanishing points are visible.

white_board.description: flat white rectangular board/tray with two small grey knobs/handles at the corners of its far (upper) edge; the only white large object
white_board.visible_frames: 0-48 (frames 0-20 cut by the bottom image edge and/or watermark; fully visible 21-48)
white_board.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the visible white mask (visible centre). minrect_cx/cy = centre of min-area rectangle.

frame_0_rest_cut.note: bottom part out of frame; visible part only

white_board.long_axis_angle_deg: ~21 deg at rest (image, y down, clockwise from +x), ~10-13 deg during motion

trash_bin.description: dark navy bin/basket with yellow and white confetti pattern, top-left
trash_bin.note: seen obliquely from above: top rim ellipse visible at y~110-135; height_px is the image-vertical extent incl. rim

tote_bag.description: navy blue tote bag lying flat with round pink/beige logo and dark handle loop, right of centre
tote_bag.note: body ~ 772-880 x, handle loop extends to x~895

carton.description: small white printed drink carton / box lying on its side, centre-lower-left
carton.note: box lying obliquely (top face + side visible); longest visible extent ~69 px, roughly image-vertical; box edges are diagonal so this is approximate

teddy_bear.description: brown/orange teddy bear (plush toy) lying on its back, bottom centre
teddy_bear.note: head at right (~x 650-690), feet/legs at left; long axis = head-to-feet

events.event: board motion start (first sub-pixel shift at 16, clear motion at 17)
board fully inside frame (no longer cut by bottom edge/watermark)
probable dropped frame: step 35->36 is ~31 px vs ~15 px neighbours
board still moving at last frame (step ~12.5 px/frame, slowly decreasing)

motion_direction: board moves up-left in the image (from ~(957,630) to ~(548,278)), nearly straight line, i.e. away from the camera across the floor; slight rotation of its long axis from ~21 deg to ~10 deg (frames 16-26) then back to ~12.5 deg
